description:
Welcome to Sparky Electricians, led by Ewart Foster — Licensed Electrical Inspector and Contractor in Jamaica.

This channel shares practical, real-world electrical knowledge to help you install, inspect, and comply with Jamaican standards the right way.

We cover:
	•	Electrical installations & best practices
	•	Inspections & compliance (GER & JPS)
	•	Compliance certificates
	•	Electrical design
	•	Professional engineer consultancy
	•	Grid connection & prepaid meters
	•	Solar systems & power solutions
	•	Electrical safety & training

We follow recognized standards such as the NEC (available on Amazon) and BSJ 316 (available on the Bureau of Standards Jamaica website).

Whether you’re in Jamaica or the diaspora, this platform helps you learn the trade properly and move forward with confidence.

For electrical work, inspections, training, or guidance:
📞 Call: 876-230-2437
🌐 Visit: https://jmelectricians.com/


Subscribe and learn the trade the right way.
